title: Tumbler Toothbrush Holder Wall Mount Solid Brass 4.5-Inch | Brass Toothbrush Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Stop losing counter space to loose cups and toothbrushes. This wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder (also called a toothbrush tumbler holder or wall tumbler holder) keeps daily essentials organized and easy to reach in the bathroom.

Highlights:
- More room on the vanity—wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging installation stores the tumbler/toothbrushes off the countertop
- Built for long-term bathroom use—solid brass construction (brass construction) provides a sturdy, rust-free accessory
- Cleaner look on the wall—concealed screw mounting hardware keeps fasteners out of sight
- Coordinate matching accessories—part of the Brass Toothbrush Holders collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Wall mounted tumbler and toothbrush holder
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Concealed screw wall-mount hardware included
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 4.7 x 3.5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.

Style notes: A smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.
